limits: This reviews recorded root-owned GPU work; reviewer did not observe a new context or independently rerun hardware.
Six dynamic VBO byte totals are neither total GPU memory nor full-frame transfer measurements.
Synthetic resolved field/index upload is not a real light-field bake, optical image equality or native-density acceptance.
First allocation and warm mirror intervals are not a comparative benchmark and do not imply FPS improvement.
Historical viewport source suite remains blocked before assertions on pre-existing prepare/bind drift, not relabeled passed.
Main/UI restoration and broader scene/persistent-smoke goals remain separate root acceptance work.
